name: Fairmont Chengdu
positioning: Fairmont city hotel in Chengdu's Hi-Tech Zone, next to the SKP shopping mall
best_for: Travelers who want a shopping-focused base next to SKP
Guests who like a private lounge with the Fairmont Gold level

facts.text: The hotel's address is 269 Tianfu Avenue Middle Section, Hi-Tech Zone, Chengdu.
The hotel is next to the SKP shopping mall, with a close connection to luxury brands.
Miku has a stylish Art Deco design and special Josper grills.
Spectrum is the all-day dining restaurant, with a la carte dishes and buffets prepared throughout the day.
CUBE serves coffee from a Bezzera Golden Eagle coffee machine from Italy.
Each guest room has a Sealy mattress and high-tech amenities.
Floor-to-ceiling windows show a panoramic view of the city skyline.
Fairmont Gold rooms give access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge, described as a hotel within a hotel.
The swimming pool is on the 4th floor.

highlights.text: Miku has a stylish Art Deco design and special Josper grills.
CUBE serves coffee from a Bezzera Golden Eagle coffee machine from Italy.
Fairmont Gold rooms give access to the Fairmont Gold Lounge, described as a hotel within a hotel.
The chef team changes the afternoon tea with the seasons.
The Signature Suites have floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking Tianfu Avenue.

considerations.text: The hotel is in the Hi-Tech Zone on Tianfu Avenue, next to a shopping mall.
Metro Line 18 goes to Tianfu International Airport.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing reflects the luxury positioning.
